title: Lucky Horse Vase
description: A large hand-painted canvas. Layers of textured acrylic give depth and scale to this highly impactful original. It would be perfect in a playroom, or above a fireplace.

images.alt: Lucky Horse Vase by Calico Melton: a large pink canvas of a dark brown vase with a white horse on it and red tulips on green stems, on a green base, propped on a wooden bench.
